mandatory_requirements: BMI must be 35 or above with at least one obesity-related comorbidity
BMI must be 40 or above regardless of comorbidities
Documented failure of non-surgical weight loss for minimum 6 months
Pre-authorization from insurer mandatory before procedure
insurer_obligations: All CCHI-licensed insurers must cover bariatric surgery when criteria met
Pre-authorization must be processed within 15 business days
Denial must include written justification and appeal rights
member_rights: Right to appeal denial within 30 days
Right to second medical opinion at insurer expense
Right to expedited review in urgent cases within 72 hours
bariatric_surgery.conflicting_notes: CCHI mandates coverage when criteria met. Individual plan terms may impose additional requirements beyond CCHI minimums.
